rule: A LICENCE IS A DOCUMENT, NOT A SHORT NAME. Every row below was determined by fetching the licensor's own page/file and quoting it. Data licence and code/devkit licence are ALWAYS separate columns. The short-name error has been made twice in this program (ZOD 2026-07-13; nuScenes CC-BY-NC-4.0 -> CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 2026-07-26).

determinations.version_resolution: The /license/ page prose says only 'CC BY-SA' with NO version number; the hyperlink target is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ and the README says '4.0' explicitly. Version 4.0 is therefore established by the link target + README, NOT by the prose. Recorded because reading the prose alone would have left the version unresolved.

determinations.commercial_use: PERMITTED. CC BY-SA 4.0 has no NonCommercial term. The licensor states on the home page: 'ZOD is currently the only AD dataset released under the permissive CC BY-SA 4.0 license, allowing for both commercial and non-commercial use.'

ADDITIONAL_TERMS_BEYOND_THE_CC_GRANT.mandatory_notice_quote: Any public use, distribution, or display of this dataset must contain this entire notice: For this dataset, Zenseact AB has taken all reasonable measures to remove all personally identifiable information, including faces and license plates. To the extent that you like to request removal of specific images from the dataset, please contact privacy@zenseact.com.
ADDITIONAL_TERMS_BEYOND_THE_CC_GRANT.field_of_use_quote: The purpose of Zenseact is to save lives in road traffic. We encourage use of this dataset with the intention of avoiding losses in road traffic. ZOD is not intended for military use.
ADDITIONAL_TERMS_BEYOND_THE_CC_GRANT.why_this_matters: A bare 'CC-BY-SA-4.0' short name carries NEITHER of these. The mandatory-notice clause is an obligation on every public use/distribution/display and must be reproduced verbatim in any artifact or paper. This is exactly the class of thing the licence-as-a-document rule exists to catch.

determinations.TRAP_RECORDED: Overture is widely described as 'CDLA-Permissive-2.0'. That is TRUE OF THE FOUNDATION, and FALSE OF THE TRANSPORTATION THEME, which is the only theme we would use. Taking the headline short name would have recorded a permissive non-copyleft licence where the real one is copyleft. Same root-cause class as the ZOD and nuScenes short-name errors.
determinations.commercial_use: PERMITTED. ODbL has no NonCommercial term.
determinations.share_alike_note: ODbL share-alike attaches to the DATABASE and to Derivative Databases. Whether a model trained on it is a Derivative Database or a Produced Work is a genuine legal question this agent is NOT competent to settle. Recorded as an OPEN QUESTION for the PI, not as a determination.

determinations.connectivity_finding: NOT lane-level. metadrive/component/road_network/node_road_network.py stores graph: Dict[str, Dict[str, List[AbstractLane]]] i.e. graph[start_node][end_node] = [lanes]. Successor relations are between NODES (roads), not between individual lanes; lanes sharing a road are grouped in a list with no explicit lane->lane successor. This is a road-level graph like Overture, not a lane-level graph like AV2.

determinations.mirror_analysis: The HF copy is a THIRD-PARTY re-host, but PandaSet is CC-BY-4.0, which grants redistribution explicitly. So this is a permitted redistribution, NOT the forbidden mirror-of-a-gated-corpus case (which is defined by a licence/terms that forbid redistribution, e.g. nuScenes imagery in OpenLane-V2 subset_A). Recorded because the distinction is easy to get backwards in both directions.
